'''Nevar Yalnal''' was a [[Ranat]] with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Objets" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1|Nevar Yalnal's appearance}}</ref> Yalnal spent [[time]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]]<ref name="Objets" /> on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. After the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] sold his [[X-34 landspeeder]] to the [[speeder]] vendor [[Wioslea]], Yalnal walked past the [[landspeeder]] while wearing a brown [[Clothing|robe]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nevar Yalnal first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character's mask was made by creature designer [[Stuart Freeborn]] and consisted mostly of hard foam and fake hair. The mask split in two when opened to allow the extra to put it on and was held in place by magnets inserted into the foam once closed. In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first named in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]'', which was written by [[Patrice Girod]] and [[Arnaud Grunberg]].<ref name="Objets" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the name originated on a card in the [[1995]] ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' set for ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''. published by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Nevar Yalnal}}</ref>
